title: 菊花賞の後に・得られた言葉は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo is ecstatic after winning the Kikuka Sho. Before her excitement wears off, she calls up her mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surely now, her mother will recognize her skill. However, her mother's remarks seem all too superficial. Is she still not convinced?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd also seems bent on bursting King Halo's bubble. Even in their cheer and praise, they refuse to acknowledge her as anything but "her mother's daughter."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, it seems King Halo has done some thinking alone. She asks me if I'm ready to throw everything away with her.
